messages:
Priya V: Hey all 040: first week here. I can read the Notion onboarding & templates but can't edit. Where are the canonical templates (PM/Eng) stored exactly, and what's the contributor flow?
Dana R: welcome Priya! :tada: Canonical set is in the shared workspace 'Redwood Docs (Shared)' > Templates > Onboarding.
Priya V: I can open the shared workspace but pages are view-only and the top says 'Contact owner to edit'. Tried request access button, it goes to a generic admin queue.
Kofi (Docs Admin): Hi Priya 040: quick path: we add folks to the 'docs-contributors' SSO group for edit rights. If you need to make immediate changes, duplicate the page to your personal workspace, edit, then file a PR via our docs-contrib flow (details below).
Priya V: docs-contrib flow? can you link docs?
Kofi (Docs Admin): Sure. Steps: 1) Duplicate template to your workspace. 2) Make edits. 3) In the template page, click Share > Invite > paste docs-bot@redwood to submit a contribution. That runs an automated review that creates a GitHub PR against docs-templates repo with the content and metadata. Docs team reviews and merges. Docs Bot will then sync the merged version back into the shared workspace.
Taylor (IT): To be added to 'docs-contributors' we need a ticket: https://forms.redwood.internal/it-access (choose Notion > Contributor). Manager approval helps speed it up. Typical ETA 30-60m.
Priya V: ok my manager is Dana R. I'll submit the form now. If I follow the duplicate+share step will the bot preserve images/subpages?
Kofi (Docs Admin): It preserves subpages if you duplicate with subpages. Images should be attached; the bot archives them into the PR. For tricky embeds (Figma, Loom) sometimes manual copy is needed.
DevEx Bot: Reminder: Onboarding checklist step "Notion edit rights" appears incomplete. Reply "manager: NAME" to auto-notify docs-admins.
Priya V: manager: Dana R
Dana R: approved the IT form. Kofi, can you watch for Priya's contribution?
Kofi (Docs Admin): Will do. Also note conventions: page titles must include team prefix like "[PM] 040 040040" and leave a one-line summary at the top. We also require a small metadata block at bottom: Owner, Last updated, Related repos.
Priya V: good to know. one more Q: if I want to create a brand-new template (not edit existing) do I still need PR flow?
Kofi (Docs Admin): Yes, new templates go through the same contribution PR so we can review structure and searchability. If it's for a private team doc, mention that in the PR and we can set perms accordingly.
Priya V: all right, thanks everyone. I filled the IT form and duplicated a draft. Will submit via docs-bot shortly.
Taylor (IT): You're added to docs-contributors. If anything fails with SSO ping me.
Priya V: confirmed I can edit now. Kofi I'll submit the contrib in ~10m. Thanks!
